quality_expectations.text: Skipped BUG tests actually fail when unskipped (bug is real, not a false positive)
quality_expectations.evidence: Key verifications: (1) NaN bug (line 191) — NaN < 0 and NaN > 150 both return false in JS, so validateUser returns valid=true for NaN, but test expects valid=false — real failure. (2) normalizeEmail no-@ bug (line 520) — split('@') on 'nodomain' gives domain=undefined, calling undefined.toLowerCase() throws TypeError not Error, so 'not.toThrow(TypeError)' assertion fails — real failure. (3) formatUserDisplay empty tags bug (line 662) — [].join(',') returns '' not null/undefined, so ?? 'none' does not trigger, output is '[Tags: ]' not '[Tags: none]' — real failure. All bugs are confirmed against the actual implementation in user_validator.ts.
